title: kblane.commit_paths drops an entry when either mode is a gitlink, so a plain file that replaces a kb gitlink (or the reverse) is left out and the commit counts as content
goal: kblane.commit_paths leaves an entry out only when every non-zero mode of it is 160000
repro_reason: needs a repository where a commit turns the gitlink kb/team into a regular file; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 5 (S3). kblane.py:100-103 tests _GITLINK in modes, so either mode being 160000 drops the entry. Planted: a commit that turns the gitlink kb/team into a regular file kb/team gives commit_paths -> [] (content), where a regular kb/README.md is code. Fix: drop only when old and new are each 000000 or 160000.
